pictures.scene: Gerrit van Honthorst, King David Playing the Harp — the king in his crown and fur-trimmed robe with his eyes raised and his mouth open in song, one hand laid on the strings, a Miktam of David, preserve me O God

pictures.scene: Johannes Oertel, Rock of Ages — a woman swept up out of the breaking sea, holding on to the stone cross with both arms while the wreckage washes past below her, for in You I take refuge, I said to the LORD You are my Lord
pictures.name: pd_oertel_rock_of_ages_trim

pictures.scene: Albrecht Durer, Adoration of the Trinity — the Father holding up the crucified Son with the dove between them, the ranks of saints and martyrs kneeling on either side, apart from You I have no good thing, as for the saints in the land
pictures.name: pd_durer_all_saints

pictures.scene: Adolph Tidemand, Low Church Devotion — a lay preacher standing with an open book in his hands and the country people crowded close around him to hear it, they are the excellence in whom all my delight resides
pictures.name: pd_tidemand_low_church_devotion

pictures.scene: Nicolas Poussin, The Adoration of the Golden Calf — the gilded calf standing on its garlanded altar with the people dancing in a ring below it and Moses lifting the tablets on the hillside behind, sorrows will multiply to those who chase other gods
pictures.name: pd_poussin_golden_calf

pictures.scene: Jacob de Roore, The Idolatry of Jeroboam — the king in his crown standing on the steps with both hands spread, the black smoke of the altar going up beside him and the gold vessels set out at his feet, I will not pour out their libations of blood, or speak their names with my lips
pictures.name: pd_deroore_afgoderij_van_jerobeam

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, The Supper at Emmaus — Christ breaking the bread at the white-clothed table with the light breaking out around His head, the two disciples on either side of Him and the boy bringing in the dish, the LORD is my chosen portion and my cup, You have made my lot secure
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_supper_at_emmaus

pictures.scene: Philips Koninck, Panoramic Landscape — the flat country opening out under a tall sky, the farm among its trees, the river running away to the horizon and one traveller on the sandy road below, the lines of my boundary have fallen in pleasant places
pictures.name: pd_koninck_panoramic_landscape

pictures.scene: Julius Schnorr von Carolsfeld, Ruth in the Field of Boaz — Boaz in his red cloak at the edge of the standing corn with his young servant beside him pointing out across the field, surely my inheritance is delightful, I will bless the LORD who counsels me
pictures.name: pd_schnorr_ruth_in_boaz_field

pictures.scene: Caspar David Friedrich, Two Men Contemplating the Moon — the two standing on the path at dusk with a hand laid on the other's shoulder, the thin crescent moon low in the sky past the bare branches, even at night my conscience instructs me, I have set the LORD always before me
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_two_men_contemplating_the_moon

pictures.scene: Caspar David Friedrich, Rocky Landscape — the tall rock towers standing up out of the mist above the ravine, with the fallen trunk and the torn roots lying below them, because He is at my right hand I will not be shaken
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_rocky_landscape

pictures.scene: Hans Memling, Angels Making Music — three angels in white robes standing on the cloud against the gold, playing the psaltery, the long bowed string and the tambourine, therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices
pictures.name: pd_memling_musicerende_engelen

pictures.scene: Eugene Delacroix, Christ Asleep during the Tempest — Christ asleep in the boat with the gold light around His head while the disciples strain at the oars and the dark water runs under them, my body also will dwell securely, for You will not abandon my soul to Sheol
pictures.name: pd_delacroix_christ_asleep_tempest

pictures.scene: Matthias Grunewald, The Resurrection — Christ risen above the open grave inside a great disc of light, His wounded hands lifted and the soldiers thrown down in their armor below, nor will You let Your Holy One see decay
pictures.name: pd_grunewald_resurrection

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, Christ in Glory — Christ enthroned in a blue mandorla ringed with angel faces, His hand raised, the saints standing in ranks on the gold around Him, You will fill me with joy in Your presence, with eternal pleasures at Your right hand
pictures.name: pd_fra_angelico_christ_in_glory

lines.text: A Miktam of David.
Preserve me, O God,
for in You I take refuge.
I said to the LORD, “You are my Lord;
apart from You I have no good thing.”
As for the saints in the land,
they are the excellence
in whom all my delight resides.
Sorrows will multiply
to those who chase other gods.
I will not pour out their libations of blood,
or speak their names with my lips.
The LORD is my chosen portion and my cup;
You have made my lot secure.
The lines of my boundary
have fallen in pleasant places;
surely my inheritance is delightful.
I will bless the LORD who counsels me;
even at night my conscience instructs me.
I have set the LORD always before me.
Because He is at my right hand,
I will not be shaken.
Therefore my heart is glad
and my tongue rejoices;
my body also will dwell securely.
For You will not abandon my soul to Sheol,
nor will You let Your Holy One see decay.
You have made known to me the path of life;
You will fill me with joy in Your presence,
with eternal pleasures at Your right hand.
